Spacing 12

The raw steps. A component uses the roles built on them: space-inset-* for padding, space-stack-* for vertical margins, space-gap-* for gaps.

StepValueSize

Radius 7

Each role has a design value and a range it stays within.

  • Pills: every action, chip and framework selector.

    More

    More

  • Emphasis and catalog cards.

    More

    Never a circle: capped at 28px. Range 4px to 28px.

  • Icon tiles, stat badges and nav link rows.

    More

    Range 2px to 12px.
